summary: Verified Course Details page (public) + Admin > Courses tab for Equity Research Analyst course. All new sections render correctly with DB-driven content, old comparison table removed, admin edit modal is opaque and PATCH works, brochure/intro-video upload buttons fail with clean readable messages (as expected pre-migration).
verified_checks: Hero h1 renders 'Equity Research Analyst' (DB-driven title).
long_description paragraph shows including '...Big 4 advisory.' and renders as two paragraphs cleanly.
What you'll be able to do list shows DB-driven items ('How to read and decode Indian annual reports end to end', 'Building 3-statement financial models from scratch').
data-testid=detail-transformation present with ₹4 LPA / ₹12 LPA before/after cards; no horizontal overflow at 1920 or 390 viewport (scrollWidth-clientWidth = 0 on both).
data-testid=detail-practical-skills, detail-instructor-section (Utkarsh Maru, Sarthak Bhatia), detail-reviews-section all present.
Old data-testid=detail-deep-compare NOT present. 'How Valuevade compares' string absent from page.
detail-download-brochure and detail-intro-video ABSENT from page (expected pre-migration), no console error, no broken layout.

Admin > Courses tab: GET /api/admin/courses returns 200 with 6 courses; 5 COMING SOON tags shown for placeholder courses; ONLY the Equity Research Analyst row shows 'Edit Details' + 'Preview & Free Sessions' buttons (1 each). Each row shows 3 upload buttons (photo/brochure/intro-video) = 6 brochure + 6 video buttons total.

Edit Details modal is OPAQUE (bg-elevated) with darkened backdrop – see-through bug is fixed. Contains all 5 fields: Course description, What you'll be able to do, Prerequisites, Career outcomes, Skills you'll gain – all pre-filled with real data (one item per line textareas).
PATCH /api/admin/courses/{id} with edited textarea → 200 {ok:true}, modal closes automatically.

POST /api/admin/courses/{id}/brochure with a PDF → 400 with clean JSON body {"detail":"File is empty or too small."}. Frontend catches via alert() showing 'Brochure upload failed: File is empty or too small.' – readable, not a raw stack trace or blank screen. Migration-503 hint path would surface identically.
critical_code_review_comments: CoursesTab.jsx uses window.alert() for upload errors (line 280, 290). Works and is readable, but a toast/snackbar would be a better UX than a blocking browser alert. Non-blocking, minor.
GET /api/admin/waitlist is hit twice on initial admin load (redundant fetch). Minor perf nit.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Migration 0047 (brochure_url/intro_video_url columns on master_paths) is not yet run by user – this is expected. Once run, the detail-download-brochure and detail-intro-video sections should conditionally appear when a course has those URLs populated via the admin uploader. All other new detail-page sections and admin upgrades verified working.
